headword: {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}け
reading: じょうきゅうしゃむけ
gloss: for advanced users; aimed at advanced learners

definitions.gloss: for advanced users; intended for advanced learners; aimed at experts
definitions.explanation: Designed for or aimed at people who already have a high level of skill or experience. Commonly seen as a label on textbooks, courses, tutorials, products, or ski slopes. Contrasted with {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け (for beginners).

examples.japanese: {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けの{本|ほん}。
このコースは{上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けです。
examples.english: This course is for advanced learners.

examples.japanese: {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けの{問題|もんだい}は、{思|おも}ったより{難|むずか}しかった。
examples.english: The problems for advanced learners were harder than I expected.

examples.japanese: このスキー{場|じょう}には{初心者|しょしんしゃ}コースも{上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けコースも{揃|そろ}っている。
examples.english: This ski resort has both beginner courses and advanced courses.

notes:
Composed of {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ} (advanced person, advanced learner) and the productive suffix ～{向|む}け (aimed at, intended for, targeted at). The suffix ～{向|む}け attaches to a noun referring to a group of people and forms a noun or modifier meaning "intended for [that group]."

USAGE:
- As a の-modifier: {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けの{教材|きょうざい} (materials for advanced learners)
- As a predicate: このコースは{上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けです (This course is for advanced learners)
- Common on textbooks, language courses, software tutorials, cooking recipes, hiking trails, and ski slopes

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けの{本|ほん}: a book for advanced readers
- {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けコース: an advanced-level course
- {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けの{問題|もんだい}: advanced-level problems
- {上級者向|じょうきゅうしゃむ}けに{作|つく}られている: designed for advanced users

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け: for beginners — the direct antonym
- {中級者向|ちゅうきゅうしゃむ}け: for intermediate learners — the middle level
- {初心者向|しょしんしゃむ}け: for beginners / newcomers — close in meaning to {初級者向|しょきゅうしゃむ}け, slightly more beginner-friendly in nuance
- {経験者向|けいけんしゃむ}け: for experienced people — broader; emphasizes experience rather than proficiency level
